settings.hint.music_dir: Absolute path as the app sees it (inside the container, for example /music).
settings.hint.library_source: Where the library is read from: the folder or Plex.
settings.hint.library_scan_cron: How often the library is scanned for new and changed files. Times use the server time zone.
settings.hint.plex_token: Needed to read the library. It is never shown again after saving.
settings.hint.plex_music_section: Name of the Plex library that holds the music.
settings.hint.library_path_map: How Plex sees your files = how this app sees them, for example /data/music=/music. One rule per line or separated by ;
settings.hint.slskd_api_key: Created in the SLSKD configuration. It is never shown again after saving.
settings.hint.mb_user_agent: Required by MusicBrainz: application name and version plus a contact, for example Diskko/0.1 ( you@example.com ).
settings.hint.mb_cache_ttl_days: How long MusicBrainz answers are reused before asking again.
settings.hint.mb_refresh_days: Artists whose metadata is older than this are synchronized again.
settings.hint.coverart_enabled: Fetch album covers from the Cover Art Archive.
settings.hint.lastfm_api_key: Used for similar artists; ListenBrainz is the fallback. It is never shown again after saving.
settings.hint.default_quality: The minimum quality a download must reach unless a request says otherwise.
settings.title: Settings
settings.secret_keep: leave empty to keep the current value
settings.check.ok: Folder found: {n} item(s) at the top level.
settings.check.not_found: The folder does not exist (yet). You can still save it, for example if the volume is not mounted.
settings.check.not_directory: This path is a file, not a folder.
settings.check.not_readable: The folder exists but this app cannot read it.
settings.library.path_warning: Changing the folder does not move any file. The next scan compares it with the previous library and stops, changing nothing, if most of it would disappear.
settings.group.plex.hint: Reads the music library and, later, rescans it after imports.
settings.group.slskd.hint: Searches and downloads from the Soulseek network.
settings.group.musicbrainz.hint: Artist and album metadata. Requests are limited to 1 per second.
settings.jobs.intro: How many jobs of each kind run at the same time. Changes apply immediately; lowering a number lets the jobs already running finish first.
settings.queue.default.hint: Connection tests, cleanups and the like.
settings.queue.library.hint: Reading the music folder or Plex.
settings.queue.musicbrainz.hint: Always 1: MusicBrainz allows one request per second.
settings.queue.slskd.hint: Searching Soulseek and following downloads. Each running download keeps a worker busy, so leave room for new searches.
settings.albums.types_hint: Which kinds of releases count as missing albums. The choice is the same for every user.
settings.error.invalid_characters: Contains characters that are not allowed.
settings.error.url_invalid: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
settings.error.url_credentials: Do not put a user name or password in the address.
settings.error.number_range: The number is outside the allowed range.
settings.error.choice_invalid: Choose one of the listed values.
settings.error.secret_invalid: Not a valid value (no spaces, at most 512 characters).
preferences.language_hint: The language of the interface, every time you sign in.
preferences.theme.auto.hint: Follows the light or dark setting of your device.
error.preferences_invalid: Choose a language and a theme from the lists.
users.reset_hint: The user is signed out everywhere.
quality.title: Quality profiles
quality.intro: A file gets the best profile it meets, from the top of the list down; an album is as good as its weakest track. The default profile is the one new requests aim for.
quality.rule.lossy_v0: At least {kbps} kbps, V0 or lossless
quality.delete_confirm: Delete this profile? Albums that used it are re-evaluated.
quality.restore_confirm: Replace every profile with the initial ones? Your changes will be lost.
quality.field.name: Name
quality.hint.bit_depth: Files with an unknown depth count as 16-bit.
quality.hint.sample_rate: Files with an unknown rate count as 44.1.
quality.recomputing: The library is being re-evaluated with the new profiles.
error.quality_name_invalid: The name is too long or contains invalid characters.
error.quality_name_taken: Another profile already has this name.
error.quality_number: Enter a valid number within the allowed range.
error.quality_delete_default: The default profile cannot be deleted: choose another default first.
error.quality_delete_last: The last profile cannot be deleted.
search.title: Search artists
search.label: Artist name
search.hint: Type at least two letters. Artists you do not own show their full discography ready to download.
similar.unavailable: Similar artists need a Last.fm API key or a contact in the MusicBrainz User-Agent (Settings > Integrations).
similar.failed: Could not load the similar artists.
similar.credit: Similar artists from Last.fm or ListenBrainz.
requests.title: Download requests
requests.intro: Your requests and how they are going. Each album is searched on Soulseek and downloaded from the best candidate.
requests.intro_all: Everyone's requests and how they are going.
requests.empty: No requests yet. Open an artist and press “Request download” on a missing album.
requests.choose_hint: Pick the folder to download. The score weighs the name, the number of tracks, the quality and how available the user is.
flash.request_created: Request sent: it is being searched.
error.request_not_choosing: This request is not waiting for a choice.
error.request_not_retryable: Only a failed, cancelled or empty request can be searched again.
error.request_no_slskd: SLSKD is not set up yet.
settings.hint.downloads_dir: The folder SLSKD saves into, as this app sees it (the mounted /downloads). Optional: it is only used to check that finished files arrived.
settings.hint.slskd_mode: Automatically picks the best candidate, or lets the person who asked choose among the best few.
settings.hint.slskd_search_timeout: A search ends when no new answer has arrived for this long.
settings.hint.slskd_candidates: How many folders are kept (and shown for a manual choice).
integration.result.soulseek_offline: SLSKD answers but is not connected to the Soulseek network.
album.local_hint: This album is in your library but is not matched to MusicBrainz, so there are no previews or downloads for it.
album.col.title: Title
album.note.not_playable: Your browser cannot play this format.
album.loading: Looking for the tracks and previews…
album.failed: Something could not be loaded; try again later.
album.no_tracks: No tracks are known for this album.
album.no_previews: No previews are available for this album.
albums.empty: No albums in the library yet. An administrator can run a scan.
albums.sort.title: Title
album.upgrade.title: Quality upgrade
album.upgrade.now: This copy is {quality}, below the minimum quality ({minimum}). Ask for a better one and it is searched and downloaded like any request.
album.upgrade.last_failed: The last attempt found nothing suitable.
error.request_bad_target: Choose a quality better than the current one.
jobs.search_placeholder: Text in any log line, label or type…
jobs.search_short: Type at least 3 characters to search.
jobs.search_found: {n} job(s) with “{q}” in a log line, label or type.
settings.retention.title: How long jobs and their logs are kept
settings.retention.intro: Finished jobs older than this are deleted every night, together with their logs (at least 1 day). Routine jobs are the ones that run all day: service checks and the cleanup itself.
settings.hint.job_retention_routine_days: Service checks and the cleanup, whatever their outcome.
settings.hint.job_retention_success_days: Every other job that succeeded or was cancelled.
settings.hint.job_retention_failed_days: Every other job that failed: they explain what went wrong.
settings.hint.job_retention_overrides: Optional, “type:days” separated by commas, for example scan_library:90,fetch_covers:7. It wins over the values above.
settings.error.retention_invalid: Unknown job type in the list.
error.request_meets_minimum: This album already meets the minimum quality.
settings.group.providers.hint: Which service answers first and which ones take over when it fails or has nothing. A service that keeps failing is paused for a while and the job moves on, or waits in the queue without blocking the others.
settings.hint.providers_covers: Default provider first, then the fallbacks in order.
settings.hint.providers_previews: Where the 30 second previews come from.
settings.hint.providers_similar: Where similar artists come from (Last.fm needs its API key).
settings.hint.provider_breaker_threshold: Consecutive failed requests after which a service is paused.
settings.hint.provider_breaker_cooldown_: How long a failing service is left alone before it is tried again.
settings.error.providers_duplicate: Each provider can appear only once.
artist.notice.provider: This artist is not on MusicBrainz: the albums come from Deezer and may be less complete. They switch to MusicBrainz automatically if it adds the artist.
review.provider.intro: Not on MusicBrainz. Deezer has an artist with this name and albums that match the library, so its data is in use. Check that it is the right artist.
review.provider.overlap: {n} library album(s) found in its discography
settings.hint.providers_metadata: MusicBrainz is always first. Choose Deezer to fill in artists and albums that MusicBrainz does not have (only when the match is certain); leave it empty to turn that off.
settings.error.providers_first: MusicBrainz always comes first for artist and album data.
settings.integrations.intro: Connections to the services Diskko uses. Whether they are working is shown on the Status page.
settings.retention.by_type.intro: Keep the jobs of a type for a different number of days. Leave a box empty to use the general values above.
settings.library.scan.title: Scan the library
settings.library.scan.hint: Scan now for new and changed files. A full rescan re-reads every file, even the unchanged ones.
artist.top.loading: Looking for the most played tracks…
artist.top.failed: The top tracks could not be loaded.
settings.hint.providers_toptracks: Deezer gives the list with previews. Last.fm (needs its API key) gives only the list: iTunes then adds the previews it has for sure.
settings.hint.providers_bio: Wikipedia is found through MusicBrainz (it needs the artist's MusicBrainz id). Last.fm needs its API key.
flash.album_refresh_queued: Updating the album: its details, track list, previews and cover are being refreshed.
settings.library.import.title: Importing downloads
settings.library.import.hint: Where a downloaded album goes in the music folder and how its files are named. Placeholders: {artist} {album} {year} {track} {disc} {title}; numbers can have a width, like {track:02d}.
settings.hint.import_folder_template: Folders under the music folder, separated by “/”. It must contain {album}. Example: {artist}/{album} ({year}).
settings.hint.import_file_template: Without the extension. It must contain {title}. On several discs the disc number is put in front when the template has none.
settings.hint.quarantine_dir: Where a download that cannot be imported is kept, with the reason. Empty: the “quarantine” folder in the downloads folder.
settings.error.template_missing: The template must contain the required placeholder.
settings.hint.plex_refresh_enabled: After an import, Plex is asked to scan the album folder (the whole section when that is not enough).
settings.hint.plex_refresh_debounce_seco: Imports that come within this time share one scan.
settings.hint.plex_refresh_metadata: After the scan, ask Plex to refresh the metadata of the imported albums.
settings.hint.plex_refresh_timeout_minut: How long to wait for Plex to finish a scan before giving up waiting.
preferences.quality_hint: The quality your download requests aim for. Upgrades of albums you already own are chosen when you ask for them.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Who did what: requests, accounts, settings, scans and artist decisions. Passwords and secrets are never recorded.
audit.empty: Nothing in the audit log yet.
audit.action.artist.dismissed: Marked an artist as not on MusicBrainz
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing new. You are told here when a request of yours is completed, fails, finds nothing or waits for your choice.
notifications.kind.completed: Your album is in the library
notifications.kind.needs_choice: A request is waiting for your choice
settings.hint.audit_retention_days: How long who-did-what entries are kept before the nightly cleanup removes them.
requests.confirm_delete: Delete this request from the list? The downloaded files and your library are not touched.
error.request_not_deletable: A request that is still running must be cancelled before it is deleted.
footer.credits: Music data and images from MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, Wikipedia, Last.fm, Deezer and iTunes. Downloads through Soulseek (SLSKD); Plex is a trademark of Plex, Inc.
error.too_many_logins: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: A consistent copy of the database is made every night and the newest {keep} are kept. Settings, users, requests and the library index are in it; your music files are not.
backups.not_scheduled: The nightly backup is switched off (BACKUP_CRON is empty).
backups.warning: A backup holds everything the database does, including the saved tokens and API keys: store it as carefully as the database itself. To restore, stop DISKKO and replace data/app.db with the copy.
